rules.model_type: If page_type == 'Progress Note' the model_type is the page_subtype; otherwise the model_type is the page_type.
rules.codability: Decided per page_type (Codable / Non-Codable / Discharge). Every page_subtype inherits it.
rules.generic_subtype: Every page_type has one generic page_subtype with the same name. It is the fallback when no specific sub-type keyword matches.
rules.unique_subtypes: No page_subtype name in the sub_types lists appears under two page types, so page_subtype -> page_type is a function for them. The only other valid pairs are the embedded pairs (see embedded_in_progress_note).
rules.labelling: Labels are content based: a page is labelled by what dominates that page. Two exceptions depend on the document the page sits in: continuation and embedded_in_progress_note.
rules.continuation: An untitled page that reads like a Progress Note is checked against the pages before it. If it is a later page of a document that started as another page type, it takes that page type; otherwise it stays Progress Note. See arbitration.json level_3_continuation.
rules.embedded_in_progress_note: A Laboratory Data or Radiology Report page that is part of a Progress Note has page_type 'Progress Note' and page_subtype equal to that name ('Laboratory Data' or 'Radiology Report'). Its model_type is the same name, so the model's classes do not change. A lab or radiology page that stands alone keeps its own page type.
rules.untitled_notes: A visit note with no printed title is Progress Note / Progress Note whatever the specialty.
rules.no_catch_all: There is no Other / Unclassified class.

embedded_in_progress_note.note: These pairs are not in the sub_types lists and are never predicted by BERT or the keyword model. Only level 3 of arbitration.json assigns them.

page_types.description: Provider visit notes of any kind, with the summary, problem list and other sections that travel with them.

sub_types.description: Provider visit note of any kind. Catches every visit-note title that has no sub-type of its own: SOAP, H&P, consultation, established patient, encounter form, chronic disease follow-up, specialty visit notes, treatment plans and case management notes.
Summary page or summary section of a note where the title says only "Summary".
Section or page listing the diagnoses addressed at a specific visit (encounter diagnoses).
Any narrative note written by a physician about the patient.
Running list of the patient's diagnoses with no assessment attached.
Document setting out problems, goals and planned interventions (common in home health and therapy).
Page holding only signatures or an electronic signature block.
Standard outpatient visit note with a provider.
Note documenting an in-person provider evaluation, often for home health or equipment (DME) certification.
Social history section or social work report: living situation, support, tobacco and alcohol use.

page_types.description: Lab results of any kind and lab paperwork.

sub_types.description: Lab results in any layout. Also catches lab flow sheets, lab requisitions and forms, and INR / prothrombin time results.
Blood chemistry lab results (metabolic panel, kidney, liver, lipids).
Blood count lab results. Read as the lab report because it sits among lab items.
Culture and sensitivity lab results.
Urine test results.
Blood sugar reading or log (finger-stick or lab).
Results of allergy skin-prick or blood (IgE) tests.
Lab result of DNA testing for inherited conditions or drug response.
Lab genetic test using fluorescent probes to find gene or chromosome changes, mostly in cancers.

page_types.description: Imaging reports read by a radiologist.

sub_types.description: Any imaging report read by a radiologist.
Scan measuring bone density to detect osteoporosis.
Plain X-ray report; the foot is given as the example.
Computed tomography imaging report.
Imaging with sound waves (abdomen, pelvis, thyroid, etc.).
Cross-sectional imaging (CT and similar).
Magnetic resonance imaging report.
MRI of the brain.
Ultrasound imaging report (same as ultrasound).

page_types.description: Front-sheet pages with identity, insurance and registration details.

sub_types.description: Front page with patient identity, insurance and contacts. Also catches admission records and application forms.
Hospital or practice front page: patient identity, insurance, admit date and sometimes the admitting diagnosis.
Patient details page from the practice system.
Registration form or print-out created at check-in.

page_types.description: Documents written when a hospital stay or episode ends, including transfer and transition-of-care summaries.

sub_types.description: Physician's summary of a hospital stay. Also catches discharge notes and forms, transition / transfer of care documents, therapy and behavioral health discharge summaries, and Spanish discharge documents.
Note written when the patient leaves the ED or hospital (some EHRs say "Depart" for discharge).
Summary written when the patient moves to another unit or facility.
Brief combined admission and discharge record for short stays / observation.
Closing summary of a case or episode of care.
The main condition responsible for the admission. A section heading rather than a whole document.

page_types.description: Forms, consents, questionnaires, checklists and score sheets.

sub_types.description: Form where the title does not say which kind. Also catches intake and history forms, agreements, policies, pre-op checklists, pre-admission testing records and screening / health maintenance records.
Signed permission or authorization: consent to treat, surgical, transfusion or vaccine consent, release of information.
Patient-completed form with no provider note attached.
Any tick-box checklist page.
Cognitive score sheet: the 30-point Mini-Mental exam, or the shorter Mini-Cog with clock drawing.
Privacy acknowledgment or authorization form.

page_types.description: Named summary documents: clinical, visit, after-visit and patient / chart summaries, and stand-alone diagnosis lists.

sub_types.description: Named summary document: clinical summary, visit summary, after-visit summary, patient / chart summary, or a stand-alone list of diagnoses.

page_types.description: Orders for tests, medicines, treatment or equipment, and standing protocols.

sub_types.description: Any order for tests, treatment, equipment or referral.
Order for a medicine (inpatient or outpatient).
Orders written after surgery.
Orders written before surgery.
Standard care protocols or standing instructions - not specific to the patient's assessment.

page_types.description: Cardiology notes and heart tests, including interpreted EKG reports. Echo has its own page type.

sub_types.description: Heart test or cardiology report where no specific sub-type matches. Also catches cardiology notes and event monitor reports.
EKG with a physician's interpretation.
CT scan with contrast that images blood vessels, often the coronary arteries.
Heart test under exercise or drug stress, with ECG response and interpretation.
Procedure report for invasive heart catheterization: coronary angiography, pressures, stents.
Exercise stress test on a treadmill.

page_types.description: Surgery documentation: operative report plus pre-op evaluation, anesthesia and post-op records.

sub_types.description: Surgeon's report of an operation: pre/post-op diagnosis, procedure performed, findings.
Assessment before surgery to confirm fitness and risk.
Anesthesia documentation around surgery: pre-anesthesia evaluation, the intra-operative anesthesia record and the post-anesthesia note.
Short operating-room summary of the case (procedure, times, staff).
Most likely the post-anesthesia recovery record (Phase I / Phase II). The label is short, so this is inferred.
Brief operative note written right after surgery, before the full report is dictated.
Visit after surgery checking healing and complications.

page_types.description: Patient-facing discharge paperwork, including discharge medication lists.

sub_types.description: Instructions given to the patient at discharge: care at home, medicines, follow-up.

page_types.description: Phone contacts: phone encounters, phone notes, messages and triage calls.

sub_types.description: Phone contact with the patient. Also catches phone messages, call notes and triage calls.
Short note of a phone conversation with the patient.

page_types.description: Functional status, activity and daily-living assessments and generic assessment forms.

sub_types.description: Assessment of the patient's ability to manage daily tasks, mobility and self-care. Also catches activity evaluations and generic assessment forms.
Tick-box grid recording how much help the patient needs with daily activities.

page_types.description: Letters, correspondence, notices and messages.

sub_types.description: Any message passed between staff, patient or providers - no visit took place.
Administrative notice such as a privacy notice, appointment notice or coverage notice.
Provider-authored letter, e.g. a consult reply to the referring doctor or a letter summarizing a visit and its diagnoses.
keywords: I had the pleasure of seeing

sub_types.description: Automated or administrative alert (result available, reminder, status).
Outpatient (AMB = ambulatory) correspondence filed in the chart, often an EHR document category.

page_types.description: Administrative pages with no clinical content: appointments, index, fax, cover and blank pages.

sub_types.description: Administrative page with no clinical content where no specific sub-type matches: fax and cover pages, blank pages, miscellaneous document pages.
Table of contents or index of encounters, procedures or documents in the chart.
Appointment note or list of appointments.

page_types.description: Nurse triage on arrival.

sub_types.description: Nurse's first assessment of urgency on arrival: complaint, vitals, acuity.
Emergency department triage record made on arrival.

page_types.description: Medication lists, prescriptions and refill logs.

sub_types.description: List of the patient's medicines with no assessment attached.
Prescription page for medicines or supplies.
Log of prescription refill requests and approvals.

page_types.description: Nursing documentation, home health and skilled nursing visits, vitals print-outs.

sub_types.description: Nursing documentation of patient status and care given. Also catches home health and skilled nursing visit notes and vitals print-outs.
Paediatric height / weight / head-circumference percentile chart.

page_types.description: Billing, charge, coding and invoice pages.

sub_types.description: Charge sheet, superbill or claim page listing codes and fees. Diagnoses on it are billing data, not clinical documentation.
Invoice or fee page that travels with the chart when the records came through the listed retrieval channels. The source names look like internal intake channels, so this reading is inferred.

page_types.description: Heart ultrasound report.

sub_types.description: Ultrasound of the heart with physician interpretation of chambers, valves and pumping function.

page_types.description: Pathologist-read tissue, cell and molecular reports.

sub_types.description: Pathologist's diagnosis on tissue removed by biopsy or surgery.
Pathology result for a biopsy sample.
Another name for a surgical pathology report.
Report on cells (cytology) or molecular markers, signed by a pathologist.
Layer-by-layer skin cancer removal with a microscope check of each stage.

page_types.description: Heart rhythm tracings without a physician's interpretation: EKG graphs, telemetry strips, Holter recordings.

sub_types.description: Heart tracing without a physician's interpretation. Also catches telemetry strips.
The tracing itself with machine measurements and no physician interpretation.
24-48 hour wearable heart rhythm recording.

page_types.description: GI specialist notes and scope procedures.

sub_types.description: GI specialist note or procedure report; EGD is the upper-GI scope of esophagus, stomach and duodenum.
Scope examination of an internal organ (most often the upper GI tract) with findings.
Scope exam of the colon (full, or lower part only) with findings such as polyps and biopsies.
Test measuring pressure and muscle movement in the esophagus.

page_types.description: Hand-outs and instructions given to the patient.

sub_types.description: Printed teaching material about a condition, medicine or procedure.

page_types.description: Office and bedside procedure notes.

sub_types.description: Short report of a bedside or office procedure.

page_types.description: Eye care notes, tests and procedures.

sub_types.description: Visit note or report from an eye physician (MD/DO) covering eye disease assessment and plan.
Eye exam record with right-eye / left-eye (OD / OS) findings, or a retina procedure note.
Report of a laser treatment. The label does not say which; most likely an eye laser (YAG, SLT, retinal).
Photograph of the retina with interpretation; used for diabetic retinopathy and macular disease.
Optometrist exam note, including visual field testing and diabetic retinopathy screening findings.
Spectacle, contact lens or intraocular lens measurements.
Appears to be a visual / vision evaluation form; the source wording is garbled.

page_types.description: Referral, payer authorization and request paperwork.

sub_types.description: Referral, authorization or request paperwork where no specific sub-type matches, including record requests.
Order or note sending the patient to another provider or service.
Form approving a referral to another provider or service.
Note on insurer approval / prior authorization for a service.

page_types.description: Psychiatric and behavioral health notes.

sub_types.description: Psychiatric or behavioral health document where no specific sub-type matches. Also catches psychotherapy session notes.
First full assessment by a psychiatric provider, ending in a diagnosis.
Follow-up visit note by a psychiatric provider, usually medication management.
Mental health provider visit note.
Note for a group therapy session.
Record of treatment for alcohol or drug use disorder.
Test of memory and thinking to screen for dementia.

page_types.description: Evaluation forms and notes that fit no other page type.

sub_types.description: Evaluation form or note that fits no other page type.
Dietitian evaluation of nutritional status, weight and diet plan.

page_types.description: Emergency department, urgent care and ambulance notes.

sub_types.description: Emergency department provider note with history, exam, medical decision-making and disposition.
Walk-in clinic visit note for acute, non-emergency problems.
Paramedic report from the scene and during transport.

page_types.description: List of allergies and reactions.

sub_types.description: List of the patient's allergies and reactions.

page_types.description: Therapy and rehabilitation notes of every discipline.

sub_types.description: Generic report from any therapy discipline.
PT evaluation or treatment note on strength, gait and range of motion.
OT documentation on daily-living skills, upper-limb function and adaptive needs.
Plan of therapy goals and interventions.
Speech-language pathologist note on speech, cognition or swallowing.
Chiropractor visit note.
Acupuncturist treatment record.

page_types.description: Vaccine lists and vaccine administration records.

sub_types.description: Vaccine document where no specific sub-type matches.
Record of vaccines the patient has received.
Record of a vaccine being given: product, lot, site, who gave it.

page_types.description: Ear, nose and throat notes and hearing / balance tests.

sub_types.description: Ear, nose and throat specialist note or test where no specific sub-type matches.
Hearing test and audiologist's note.
ENT scope of the throat and vocal cords.
Eye-movement test for dizziness and balance disorders.

page_types.description: Wound, burn and infection control notes.

sub_types.description: Wound, burn or infection document where no specific sub-type matches.
Assessment and treatment of a wound or ulcer.
Record of burn assessment and treatment.
Note on infection status, isolation and organisms.

page_types.description: Mid-stay summaries and interim notes.

sub_types.description: Summary written part-way through a long stay.

page_types.description: Critical care physician notes and ICU flow sheets.

sub_types.description: Physician note for a critically ill patient, usually in the ICU.

page_types.description: Imaging that uses a radioactive tracer.

sub_types.description: Imaging that uses a radioactive tracer (bone scan, thyroid scan, PET, cardiac).
3-D nuclear scan, most often of the heart.
Nuclear stress scan showing blood flow to the heart muscle.

page_types.description: Doppler / duplex and other blood-flow studies.

sub_types.description: Blood-flow study of arteries or veins where no specific sub-type matches, including the ankle-brachial index.
Any Doppler or duplex ultrasound blood-flow study; the echo Doppler is given as the example.
Ultrasound of the neck arteries checking for narrowing.
Vascular ultrasound of leg or arm arteries/veins, e.g. for DVT or peripheral artery disease.
Test measuring volume changes - limb blood flow (vascular) or lung volumes (body plethysmography).

page_types.description: Work-related records and purpose-specific physicals.

sub_types.description: Work-related or purpose-specific physical exam where no specific sub-type matches. Also catches fitness-for-duty, school physical and travel medicine forms.
Employer or work-related health record.
Evaluation of a job-related injury (workers' compensation).
Pre-participation exam for athletes.

page_types.description: Yearly wellness and health-plan assessment visits.

sub_types.description: Yearly comprehensive review of the member's health, conditions and risks; often a health-plan sponsored visit.
Yearly preventive visit that updates the health risk assessment and personalized prevention plan.
Medi-Cal health behavior questionnaire reviewed and signed by the PCP.
Summary of a health-plan in-home assessment visit (e.g. the Optum HouseCalls program).

page_types.description: Pregnancy records and cervical screening.

sub_types.description: Pregnancy or women's health document where no specific sub-type matches.
Pregnancy care record kept across visits: obstetric history, due date, and a flow sheet of each prenatal visit (weight, BP, fundal height, fetal heart rate).
Same idea as the prenatal record: documentation of mother and fetus before delivery, outpatient or during an antepartum admission.
Follow-up visit after delivery (usually within 1-12 weeks) checking recovery, bleeding, breastfeeding, mood and contraception.
Cervical cytology screening result.
Magnified exam of the cervix after an abnormal Pap, usually with biopsy.

page_types.description: Neurology notes and nerve tests.

sub_types.description: Neurologist visit note, or the note accompanying an EMG study.
Brain-wave recording interpreted by a neurologist; used for seizures and encephalopathy.
Electromyography / nerve conduction test of muscles and nerves, with physician interpretation.
Sweat-gland nerve function test for small-fiber / diabetic neuropathy.
Diabetic peripheral neuropathy test result (often DPNCheck).

page_types.description: Kidney specialist notes and dialysis records.

sub_types.description: Kidney specialist visit note.
Dialysis treatment record: hemodialysis run sheet or peritoneal dialysis record.

page_types.description: Cancer care notes and treatment administration records.

sub_types.description: Cancer specialist visit note: diagnosis, staging, treatment plan.
Record of radiation treatment for cancer: site, dose, fractions.
Record of chemo drugs given, dose, cycle and tolerance.
Note for IV drug administration (biologics, iron, antibiotics, chemo).
Record of blood products given: unit numbers, times, vitals checks.

page_types.description: Respiratory therapy notes and breathing tests.

sub_types.description: Respiratory therapist note on breathing treatments and oxygen.
Oxygen saturation recording (spot check or overnight), often used to qualify for home oxygen.
Breathing test measuring lung volumes and airflow.
Record of mechanical ventilation settings and changes.

page_types.description: Sleep studies and sleep clinic notes.

sub_types.description: Sleep test or sleep clinic document where no specific sub-type matches.
Overnight sleep test with interpretation; diagnoses sleep apnea and other sleep disorders.
Sleep study with diagnosis in the first half of the night and CPAP titration in the second.
Sleep study to find the right airway pressure setting.

page_types.description: Pain management, palliative and hospice notes.

sub_types.description: Pain management visit or injection note, palliative care note on symptom control and goals of care, or hospice care record.

page_types.description: Implant records and device checks.

sub_types.description: Record of an implanted device or prosthesis.
Interrogation report of a pacemaker, ICD or loop recorder.
Operating-room log of implanted devices.
